remarks: This is the one you've been waiting for - a spacious and bright 4 bed, 4 1/2 bath colonial in a coveted neighborhood of the Hindley School district. Walk to all from a perfect location near schools, train, beaches, library, town and new Heights and Corbin district developments. This beautiful home with quality finishes including crown molding and granite countertops, has a freshly painted interior and exterior and has newly finished hardwood floors throughout, as well as brand new carpeting in the third floor additional bedroom/rec room/office space. A welcoming foyer leads you to light-filled formal living and dining rooms and the large gourmet eat-in kitchen with center island breakfast bar, new microwave, wall oand pantry closet. Off the kitchen, find a comfy family room with fireplace, built-ins and access to the peaceful and private bluestone patio and yard. Find extra pantry and storage space in the convenient mudroom that leads to attached garage and an expansive unfinished basement with high ceilings. Find 4 bedrooms on the second floor and 3 full baths, including the spacious primary bedroom suite with walk-in closet and full bath with tub and shower, and an additional ensuite bedroom. Step up to the newly refreshed third floor with another full bath and generous closets, easily accommodating an additional bedroom/au pair suite and/or recreation and office space. Enjoy the outdoors in your serene backyard with mature plantings and plenty of room to play and entertain
